children.text: Catch up on school highlights, important announcements, student achievements, and dates to remember in our August newsletter.
A connected school community

At SAIS - UAQ, every school day provides opportunities for students to explore new ideas, strengthen their skills, and contribute positively to their community. Our teachers and staff work closely with families to create a supportive environment where every learner can thrive.
We look forward to sharing more stories, achievements, and important updates with our families throughout the academic year.
